Heavy earthmoving equipment and small teams of workers are shown transforming the undulating sand dunes and natural terrain into highly organized, flat circular industrial platforms designed to hold liquid hydrocarbon assets.

This surface infrastructure manages the material exchange between the deep subsurface and the surface, filtering drill cuttings from mud to reuse the fluids.
